question.text: Beta of the MARKET portfolio is always:

explanation.text: The Logic: By definition: market beta against itself = 1. Stocks with β > 1 are more volatile than market; < 1 less volatile. The Trap: Confusing market beta with alpha or tracking error. Cross-Exam Context: CAPM fundamentals. Manager's Pro-Tip: Indexing = holding market portfolio; your portfolio beta = 1.0. Passive by design.
